title: mentha sylvestris var. nouletiana
intro: Mentha sylvestris var. nouletiana, commonly known as Woolly Mint, is a variety of the wild mint plant species, characterized by its woolly leaves and stems. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mint include its ability to soothe the digestive system, reduce nausea and vomiting, and provide relief from respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are found in the plant's essential oils.
